hook: A second baseless lawsuit against Beyoncé over her 2022 track Alien Superstar risks major financial penalties.

sections.voiceover: A second baseless lawsuit against Beyoncé over her 2022 track Alien Superstar risks major financial penalties.
Parkwood Entertainment filed court papers in California on October 15, 2026, seeking penalties. Will a California federal judge force the plaintiff and his attorney to pay legal bills?
Parkwood Entertainment claims these ownership assertions are objectively baseless and contradictory.
Music Business Worldwide reported on October 21, 2026, that the label demands payment for legal costs. This move targets the tangled copyright claims surrounding the production of Alien Superstar.
The California federal judge must now rule on these requests for financial penalties.
